metadata.case_name: SO SAU MAN AND ANOTHER v. THE HOSPITAL AUTHORITY

plaintiff.education_level: Part time course in Childhood Education at the Baptist University

source: Dr. Chung see-yuen confirms that Madam So is suffering from dysthymic disorder, a mental disorder characterised by a chronic depression of mood.

injuries.description: The ligament between her pubic bone and pelvis became stretched.
source: The ligament between her pubic bone and pelvis became stretched.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified dislocation or strain or sprain of joints or ligaments of lumbar spine or pelvis

injuries.description: severe birth asphyxia with multiple system involvement
source: At birth, her son was apnoeic, cyanosed and flaccid, and he suffered from severe birth asphyxia with multiple system involvement.
At about 4 weeks old he required surgery for a ruptured spleen.

manifestations.description: depressed mood most of the time
irritability, feelings of worthlessness, low self-esteem, lack of interest in activities and sleep problems
She cannot tolerate another pregnancy; the fear of pregnancy has affected her interest in sex and frequency of intercourse has decreased
difficulty in walking and great pain whenever she moved
apnoeic, cyanosed and flaccid at birth

treatments_received: psychotherapy (attended psychotherapy several times up to May 1997)
counselling (physician at Ngan Tam Kok Clinic gave counselling)
treatments_future: psychiatric treatment by a private psychiatrist of her choice, psychotherapy once every 2 weeks for about 15 one-hour sessions (estimated by Dr. Chung at $37,500)

losses.description: for the rest of her life she will be deprived of the family life which she had a right to expect.

losses.category: Loss of sexual function and sexual life
losses.description: decreased interest in sex and reduced frequency of sexual intercourse due to fear of pregnancy
lack of confidence with people and reduced socialising compared with pre-incident social life
Dr. Chung see-yuen confirms that Madam So is suffering from dysthymic disorder, a mental disorder characterised by a chronic depression of mood.

comparable_cases.case_name: Bagley v. North Hertfordshire Health Authority
comparable_cases.injury_description: Simon Brown J. in Bagley considered three aspects of the loss under PSLA: dashed hopes, rigours of an additional pregnancy and the plaintiff's own pain and suffering.

comparable_cases.case_name: Kerby v. Redbridge Health Authority (Unrep.) QBD 1992
comparable_cases.injury_description: Ognall J. awarded the sum of GBD 10,000.
